technical-summary: Added a repeatable read-only CDP/Gateway live monitor for configured gpt-auto DOM evidence across three turns in one provider session, verified the start/active/complete signal conjunction, and made the latest-turn completion selector localization-safe by removing its English aria-label dependency.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto completion detection is now backed by repeatable multi-turn live DOM traces and a localization-safe latest-response completion marker.

technical-summary: Made gpt-auto response freshness depend on the latest assistant data-message-id, scoped active DOM evidence to the latest assistant turn, removed broad busy/spinner policy control, added a declarative sustained empty-assistant evidence watchdog, made submission comparison exact, and hardened the live monitor's session matching and cleanup.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto now advances from identifiable per-turn DOM evidence, safely detects sustained abandoned empty responses, and avoids false completion from mutations to older responses.

technical-summary: Removed the speculative 120-second empty-response evidence watchdog and its workflow configuration because absence of recognized activity cannot prove provider failure during potentially long tool or reasoning phases.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto no longer fails long-paused responses based only on two minutes without recognized activity; only positive terminal evidence or the overall backstop ends the turn.
